articles.title: Iran's New Supreme Leader Announced Amid Missile Strikes
articles.lede: Iranians celebrate after Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei announced as new Supreme Leader, reports state media. Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has been appointed as Iran's new Supreme Leader, triggering public celebrations and pledges of support from key institutions like the IRGC. The announcement coincided with reported Iranian missile strikes on central Israel, escalating ongoing regional tensions. The conflict, now in its ninth day, has resulted in significant casualties and displacement within Iran according to reports. The humanitarian situation is deteriorating, with overwhelmed relief efforts addressing the needs of displaced populations.
